items.title: Nasdaq record; SOX rises 4.3% as AI/chip buying accelerates

items.title: Oil and US long yields retreat as risk appetite improves
items.summary: US crude fell about 4.9% to $95.43, Brent about 3.6% to $100.11 and the US 10Y yield moved below 5%, easing two recent headwinds for growth equities.
